Dogecoin Network Activity Hits Four-Month Low as Whale Transactions Plummet

Dogecoin's network activity has slumped to a four-month low, with whale transactions dwindling by a staggering 88% since late 2024. https://t.co/U6yDRjSlRd

SEC Delays Decision on XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin ETFs Amid Regulatory Scrutiny

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has postponed its decision on several exchange-traded fund (ETF) applications tied to XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin. https://t.co/z6ASe1kamM
